historical_reviews.deepseek: The literal item label is not a proven SDR record, and the single partial local fallback cannot establish BF3 DPU identity or IB/OOB parity.

historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A BlueField-3 may expose management, NIC-port and DPU thermal/health records under different labels. Its embedded operating state and link state can affect sensor availability, so evidence must bind each record to a specific DPU and state rather than rely on a BF3 substring.

original_test_intent: Validate all approved BlueField-3 DPU and port sensor records in SDR and Sensor views through verified IB and OOB paths against the platform specification.
original_method: Inventory BF3 devices by PCIe/serial/slot/management identity and operating/link state, map canonical BMC records, collect complete protected SDR and Sensor outputs through same-target IB/OOB paths, normalize association/readings/status/threshold/freshness and compare per device without changing DPU or network state.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies BF3 device/port inventory, canonical sensor map, SPEC and DPU/link-state rules; the operator resolves unavailable or ambiguous resources and sets the verdict.
required_inputs: DPU mode and port link state
safety_requirements: Never alter DPU mode, NIC link, firmware, thresholds or events
Do not accept a BF3 substring as unique identity
Never retry automatically to mask unavailable or divergent readings
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete SDR and Sensor views on both paths
Compare normalized records to state-aware SPEC
Archive evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Review missing, duplicate, stale or divergent records

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It queries an unverified title string through insecure SSH, truncates output and omits OOB and complete Sensor-list evidence, so it cannot identify the DPU or satisfy the source criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected complete `sdr elist` and `sensor list` collection through verified IB/OOB paths, then correlate canonical records with the approved BF3 device, management identity, DPU mode and port state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The four read-only views and 10/10-minute envelope are preserved; guessed identity, unsafe transport and truncation are removed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce one row per BF3 record with DPU PCIe/serial/slot identity, management endpoint, operating mode, port state, SDR entity, live Sensor value, four-path comparison and SPEC result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable DPU correlation and operating-state context before applying labels or numeric criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A BF3 grep cannot show that every DPU and expected port/resource is represented exactly once or explain state-dependent unavailable readings.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some BF3 health data may live outside IPMI while the source explicitly requires SDR/Sensor views; external telemetry can corroborate but cannot replace those required surfaces.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether BF3 means DPU-level, NIC-port-level or both sensor sets and which operating modes are valid. CX7 row 1664 is not a substitute even if device families share vendor naming.
expected_evidence: Target identity, firmware and BF3 device/port inventory
DPU mode/link state and canonical sensor map
Complete redacted SDR and Sensor outputs from IB/OOB
Per-device normalized four-way state-aware SPEC comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, BF3 filters and criteria consistently target BF3 sensor validation. Missing device mapping, state semantics and SPEC are prerequisites rather than competing objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: BF3 inventory, operating state, mapping and SPEC are obtainable project inputs. Execution reports BLOCKED if stable DPU identity or complete same-target evidence cannot be established.

review_improvement: Anchors BF3 readings to the exact DPU and operating state so an unrelated or unavailable record cannot pass through a generic family-name match.
independent_technical_reasoning: BF3 combines DPU and NIC roles, and its management plane can be available while a host-facing function or port is down. Sensor availability therefore has to be interpreted with DPU mode and link state. Identical cards also require serial/slot correlation; otherwise matching names across IB and OOB may refer to different adapters or aggregated records.
